description: Source code for InternalReporter class implementing a test reporter interface, handling test lifecycle events, error processing, and integrating with other reporter components in Playwright.

classes.name: InternalReporter
classes.description: Implements the ReporterV2 interface to handle test reporting, including lifecycle events, error handling, and output formatting.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Configures the reporter with the provided test configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test suite.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test, adding snippets to errors.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes reporting after all tests, including timing info.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Processes errors, adding location and snippets.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step, adding snippets if errors occurred.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio.
